nodes.description: Constructor initializing admin, operator, delay and admin_initialized with delay bounds validation.
Self-call only function updating the timelock delay within MINIMUM_DELAY/MAXIMUM_DELAY bounds.
Self-call only function assigning a new operator role.
Transfers admin rights to pendingAdmin and clears pendingAdmin.
Sets pendingAdmin; first call allowed only from admin via admin_initialized guard.
Queues a transaction hash for later execution by admin or operator after delay.
Admin only function that invalidates a queued transaction hash.
Admin only function executing a queued transaction and performing an external call with value.
Internal view helper returning block.timestamp for timelock delay checks.
Plain ether receiving function with no logic.
Address holding administrative privileges over timelock operations.
Address nominated to become the next admin.
Address allowed to queue transactions alongside admin.
Mandatory waiting period before a queued transaction can be executed.
One-time flag allowing the initial admin to set a pending admin.
Mapping of transaction hashes to their queued/executed status.
Constant window after eta during which a queued transaction stays executable.
Constant lower bound for the timelock delay (24 hours).
Constant upper bound for the timelock delay (30 days).
Caller address used in every access control guard of the contract.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for eta and grace period comparisons.

edges.reason: Constructor delay_ parameter is validated and stored into the delay state variable.
Constructor admin_ parameter is written into the admin and operator state variables.
setDelay delay_ parameter is bounds-checked and assigned to delay.
setOperator operator_ parameter is assigned to the operator state variable.
setPendingAdmin pendingAdmin_ parameter is assigned to pendingAdmin.
queueTransaction target parameter is hashed into the queued transaction identifier.
queueTransaction value parameter is hashed into the queued transaction identifier.
queueTransaction signature parameter is hashed into the queued transaction identifier.
queueTransaction data parameter is hashed into the queued transaction identifier.
queueTransaction eta parameter is hashed and checked against block timestamp plus delay.
Computed txHash local variable is stored into the queuedTransactions mapping.
cancelTransaction target parameter is hashed into the cancelled transaction identifier.
cancelTransaction value parameter is hashed into the cancelled transaction identifier.
cancelTransaction signature parameter is hashed into the cancelled transaction identifier.
cancelTransaction data parameter is hashed into the cancelled transaction identifier.
cancelTransaction eta parameter is hashed into the cancelled transaction identifier.
Computed txHash local variable clears the queuedTransactions entry.
executeTransaction target parameter is hashed and later used as the external call destination.
executeTransaction value parameter is forwarded as msg.value in the external call.
executeTransaction signature parameter is encoded into the call data.
executeTransaction data parameter is appended to the encoded call data.
executeTransaction eta parameter is hashed and compared against the current timestamp.
Computed txHash local variable gates the queued transaction check.
callData local variable is passed to the low-level external call.
success boolean from the external call gates the execution require check.
returnData from the external call is returned to the caller.
Constructor writes the initial admin address.
Constructor sets operator to the initial admin address.
Constructor writes the initial delay.
Constructor sets admin_initialized to false.
setDelay updates the delay state variable.
setOperator updates the operator state variable.
acceptAdmin assigns msg.sender into admin.
acceptAdmin resets pendingAdmin to the zero address.
setPendingAdmin writes the nominated admin address.
setPendingAdmin sets admin_initialized to true on the first call.
queueTransaction marks the transaction hash as queued.
cancelTransaction clears the queued flag for the transaction hash.
executeTransaction clears the queued flag before performing the external call.
getBlockTimestamp reads the miner-influenced block.timestamp value.
queueTransaction uses the timestamp helper to enforce the eta delay requirement.
executeTransaction uses the timestamp helper for eta and grace period checks.
executeTransaction reads the queuedTransactions mapping to validate the transaction was queued.
GRACE_PERIOD constant bounds the acceptable execution window.
MINIMUM_DELAY constant bounds the constructor delay check.
MAXIMUM_DELAY constant bounds the constructor delay check.
MINIMUM_DELAY constant bounds the setDelay check.
MAXIMUM_DELAY constant bounds the setDelay check.
executeTransaction forwards attacker-influenced target, value and calldata to the low-level call.
setDelay requires msg.sender to be the timelock contract itself.
setOperator requires msg.sender to be the timelock contract itself.
acceptAdmin requires msg.sender to equal pendingAdmin.
setPendingAdmin branches on msg.sender depending on admin_initialized.
queueTransaction requires msg.sender to be admin or operator.
cancelTransaction requires msg.sender to be admin.
executeTransaction requires msg.sender to be admin.
admin state variable is compared against msg.sender to authorize queueing.
operator state variable is compared against msg.sender to authorize queueing.
admin state variable authorizes cancellation of queued transactions.
admin state variable authorizes execution of queued transactions.
admin state variable authorizes the first setPendingAdmin call.
pendingAdmin state variable is the authorization check in acceptAdmin.
The external low-level call hands control to the target contract, which may re-enter executeTransaction through the Timelock's public functions.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor delay argument only flows into the constructor initialization logic.
Constructor admin argument only flows into the constructor initialization logic.
Delay parameter is consumed solely inside setDelay.
Operator parameter is consumed solely inside setOperator.
Pending admin parameter is consumed solely inside setPendingAdmin.
Target parameter is only used to build the queued transaction hash.
Value parameter is only used to build the queued transaction hash.
Signature parameter is only used to build the queued transaction hash.
Data parameter is only used to build the queued transaction hash.
Eta parameter is only used for the delay check and hash inside queueTransaction.
Local txHash is produced and stored within queueTransaction.
Local txHash is produced and used to clear the queue within cancelTransaction.
Local txHash is produced and checked within executeTransaction.
Local callData is assembled and forwarded by executeTransaction.
success is the direct result of the low-level external call and gates execution.
returnData is the direct output of the low-level external call returned to the caller.
